Anomalous drought in Brazil, 2019-2025

CHIRPS v2.0 daily rainfall, HydroBASINS level 6. A basin-day counts as drought when its 30-day rainfall total falls below the 20th percentile that the 1990-2010 baseline produced for that same day of the year, so a normal dry season is not counted.
Click a basin to see its daily trace. Grey = no drought that year.
Select a basin
The panel shows 30-day accumulated rainfall against the day-of-year drought threshold, with detected events underneath.
From basin to field: who kept growing while the rain stopped
Each button opens the most extreme basin in Brazil on that drought metric that still sits on farmland, and zooms to a 24 km window on its densest cluster of agricultural parcels. Colour carries two things at once: hue is what the weather was doing on that date - purple while the basin is in drought, green while it is not - and depth is the parcel's own NDVI. So deep purple is a full canopy while the rain has failed, and light purple is bare ground in the same drought. Press Play to run the year.
